summary: This Secret History lecture is the central source for Meritocracy Converts Wounds Into Credentials: elite schools use discretion, power-oriented selection, trauma-driven achievement, conditional parenting, and actor-like self-presentation to turn wounds into credentialed ambition.

new_lens_seeds.title: Elite Schools As Venture Capital
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: An elite school selects like a portfolio manager: many safe legacies and athletes preserve the institution, while a few risky wounded outsiders may produce fame, power, and asymmetric brand upside.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The model is vivid and may recur in education, power, and elite-network sources, but it currently fits inside Meritocracy Converts Wounds Into Credentials and does not need a standalone page.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a routing seed. Public child pressure is already satisfied by Meritocracy Converts Wounds Into Credentials.

new_lens_seeds.title: Credentialed Actor Personality
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: The credential system rewards people who can perform passion, goodness, ambition, loyalty, and moral change at once, until public leadership becomes an actorly self divided from real learning or love.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism may connect meritocracy, legitimacy fiction, attention, and political performance, but this source alone is not enough to extract a public concept.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create an Obama, JD Vance, Johnny Kim, or actor-politician page from this source. Route by active mechanism.
